name: Grey
source:
The game's reluctant protagonist who dies and discovers he's an anomaly that can't be sent to Heaven or Hell.
To determine his fate, he must complete Seven Trials in the human realm. Grey is shy, awkward and easily overwhelmed. He cares about others but rejects the big responsibility of truly influencing their fates. During the Trials, he'll be forced to confront his fears, embrace selflessness, and step into a role far bigger than he ever imagined. With the help of his Guardians, Grey may not only shape the destiny of others but finally discover the love he didn't even know he was missing.

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/seven-nexus//]official website[/url]]
